M: the combination, and the only arm allowed two changes: dueling (the one arm of the five that improved the agent: +31.5 mean score, 4/5 seeds) with the five-plane encoding (the one that made the heuristic's ranking easier to learn: 45.0% supervised agreement against 32.7% on three planes). They attack different halves -- what the value is worth, and what the network can see -- so this arm is the honest test of whether the round-2 gains add up or overlap.

Predicts: at or above K. If it lands at K's level the two do overlap; if it lands above, they compose.

training.description: dqn 6000 episodes, seed 1, lr 0.001, batch 64, buffer 50,000, gamma 0.99, eps 1->0.05 over 20,000, target every 500, 256x256, cpu, [per_piece=5]
